description: List and search Alert State Timelines from OneUptime with optional filtering, pagination, and sorting. Returns an array of Alert State Timeline objects plus the total matching count.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return. Default: 10, Maximum: 100.

query.description: Filter criteria for Alert State Timelines. Each field accepts a direct value (exact match) or an operator object {"_type": "<Operator>", "value": ...}. Operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, InBetween (numbers/dates), Search (partial text), Includes (array of values). Example — items from the last 24 hours: {"createdAt": {"_type": "GreaterThan", "value": "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"}}.

_id.description: Query operators for _id field of type Object ID. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, Includes

alertId.description: Query operators for alertId field of type Object ID. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, Includes

alertStateId.description: Query operators for alertStateId field of type Object ID. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, Includes

createdAt.description: Query operators for createdAt field of type Date. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, InBetween

createdByUserId.description: Query operators for createdByUserId field of type Object ID. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, Includes

deletedAt.description: Query operators for deletedAt field of type Date. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, InBetween

deletedByUserId.description: Query operators for deletedByUserId field of type Object ID. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, Includes

endsAt.description: Query operators for endsAt field of type Date. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, InBetween

isOwnerNotified.description: Query operators for isOwnerNotified field of type Boolean. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull

projectId.description: Query operators for projectId field of type Object ID. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, Includes

rootCause.description: Query operators for rootCause field of type Markdown. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, Search, Includes

startsAt.description: Query operators for startsAt field of type Date. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, InBetween

stateChangeLog.description: Query operators for stateChangeLog field of type JSON. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull

updatedAt.description: Query operators for updatedAt field of type Date. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, InBetween

version.description: Query operators for version field of type Number. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, InBetween

select.description: Optional: field names to return for each Alert State Timeline (e.g. ["_id", "name"]). Omit to get all readable fields. Large fields excluded by default (request explicitly if needed): stateChangeLog.

skip.description: Number of records to skip for pagination. Default: 0. Example: skip=10 to start from the 11th record.

sort.description: Sort order for results. Use "ASC" for ascending or "DESC" for descending. Example: {"createdAt": "DESC"} to sort by newest first.

name: list_alert_state_timelines
